title: Absolute expectation bounded by the second moment
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $\rho\in[0,1]$, and let $g$ be any real-valued function on the subsets of $\{1,\ldots,n\}$. The weighted average of $|g(J)|$ over subsets $J$, with each subset given weight $\rho^{|J|}(1-\rho)^{n-|J|}$, is at most the square root of the weighted average of $g(J)^2$ with the same weights.
hypotheses_covered: Arbitrary real-valued function $g$ on subsets of $\{1,\ldots,n\}$
